captions.detailed: This is a personal-scale bedside air purifier with a light gray rectangular housing and rounded vertical corners. It features a dark gray slotted intake grille on its front face, a square outlet opening on the top, and a small black rocker control switch situated next to the outlet. On the side, a pull-out filter tray with integrated slide guides can be extended, while a rear access panel is designed to swing open on a vertical hinge for maintenance.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a bedside air purifier with a light gray main body housing. It must include an integrated front intake grille, a top outlet, a small black control rocker switch that pivots locally, a pull-out filter tray that slides out on guides, and a rear access door that rotates on a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the main body housing by modeling a rounded box and subtracting internal cavities for the intake, outlet, and rear door opening. Model the front intake grille separately as a thin dark gray panel with linear slot arrays. Create the rear access door as a flat plate and attach it using a revolute joint on a vertical axis. Create the filter tray with side guides and attach it using a prismatic joint. Finally, model the small rocker switch on the top surface and attach it using a revolute joint to simulate the rocker pivot action.
